title: LEARN_MAP maps the large Learn docsets to their public MicrosoftDocs repositories, so detect decides most Learn pages by git history
goal: census.py LEARN_MAP maps the intune/ and windows/ Learn path prefixes to the public repository each page's github_feedback_content_git_url names; a census.py detect --sitemaps run before and after the change on the same day is recorded with both wall times in kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import census
sys.exit(0 if all(any(p.startswith(x) for p,_,_ in census.LEARN_MAP) for x in ('intune/','windows/')) else 1)

import re, sys
t = open('kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
L = [l for l in t.splitlines() if 'LEARN_MAP' in l and 'sitemaps' in l and any(d > '2026-10-20' for d in re.findall(r'20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d', l))]
print(L[:2])
sys.exit(0 if L else 1)

gates.question: Does LEARN_MAP map intune/ and the windows/ fallback to the repositories their pages name although those answer 404 (memdocs, windows-itpro-docs), or only prefixes whose repository answers? A 404 repository leaves its pages on Learn and its clone fails with no login prompt, about a second a run; the goal names intune/ and windows/.
options: map every prefix the pages name, 404 ones included
map only prefixes whose repository answers
gates.recommendation: map every prefix the pages name, 404 ones included
gates.answer: map only prefixes whose repository answers

gates.question: Which windows/ subpaths does LEARN_MAP map beyond the fallback, and how are the large new repositories cloned? Mapped: win32/api (sdk-api), win32 (win32, desktop-src/ has mixed-case directories that the lowercase Learn path does not match, so most of its pages stay on Learn), apps, dev-drive, dev-environment, package-manager (windows-dev-docs, hub/), terminal, wsl; left out: console (Microsoft/Console-Docs), azure/ and every other prefix. sdk-api, win32 and windows-dev-docs are cloned shallow since SHALLOW_SINCE, as the other large repositories.
options: map those subpaths and clone the three shallow
map only intune/ and windows/ itself
gates.recommendation: map those subpaths and clone the three shallow
gates.answer: map those subpaths and clone the three shallow

notes: Blocks: operator request 2026-10-20, the whole census tooling epic EP-mkzkd7in before the census of EP-aolytxc5 (ST-zpe7qxtv depends on this item), so a sprint may take this parked draft. 2026-10-20 planning: the api/ and azure/ prefixes stay out of the goal: the work maps them too only where their pages name a public repository. A prefix whose pages name no public repository is a gate, not a guess. Premises: LEARN_MAP has no intune/ or windows/ entry; fact-diff.md has no LEARN_MAP sitemaps line dated after 2026-10-20. Research ST-77p3ppiz 2026-10-21 (kb public/agents/doc-change-detection.md:54-58): intune/ pages name MicrosoftDocs/memdocs, which answers 404; windows/ and azure/ split by subpath across repositories with a repository-path rewrite each (desktop-src/, hub/, articles/), several of them 404 (windows-itpro-docs, azure-ai-docs, defender-docs); no top-level api/ prefix exists (/en-us/api/ is 404). A prefix-level intune/ or windows/ entry cannot decide pages by git history, so the goal's first clause needs the gate this note's earlier text names.
